gloss: mailing (a letter); posting (in a mailbox); dropping into a box

definitions.gloss: the act of mailing a letter or postcard by dropping it into a public mailbox or post-office collection box; the act of dropping a slip into a designated collection box (e.g. a comment box, raffle box, or election ballot box)
definitions.explanation: The standard formal word for the action of putting a letter, postcard, application form, or similar item into a collection box. Most often used about postal mail dropped into a {郵便|ゆうびん}ポスト (street mailbox), but it also covers ballot voting, prize-draw entries, and any context in which something is dropped into a labelled box. Used as a noun and as a する-verb ({投函|とうかん}する 'to mail, to post').

examples.japanese: ⟦{手紙|てがみ}→手紙：00675_tegami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{投函|とうかん}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ポスト→ポスト：02965_posuto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{葉書|はがき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{投函|とうかん}してきた。
examples.english: I just dropped a postcard in the mailbox in front of the station.

examples.japanese: ⟦{応募|おうぼ}→応募：03014_oubo⟧⟦{用紙|ようし}→用紙：09588_youshi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{切手|きって}→切手：00718_kitte⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{貼|は}って→貼る：10447_haru⟧、⟦{締|し}め{切|き}り→締め切り：04162_shimekiri⟧{日|び}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{投函|とうかん}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please put a stamp on the application form and mail it by the deadline.

examples.japanese: ⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{近|ちか}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ポスト→ポスト：02965_posuto⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{歩|ある}いて→歩く：00538_aruku⟧、⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧な⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{投函|とうかん}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I walked to the nearby mailbox in the rain and mailed an important document.

notes:
Composed of {投|とう} ('to throw') + {函|かん} ('box'). The character {函|かん} is the same as ⟦{箱|はこ}→箱：02162_hako⟧ ('box') and is the formal Sino-Japanese reading. Literally 'to throw into a box'.

USAGE:
{投函|とうかん} is the standard, slightly formal word used in postal contexts and on instructions for mail and applications. It is the word the Japanese postal service (⟦{日本|にっぽん}→日本：00320_nippon⟧⟦{郵便|ゆうびん}→郵便：03803_yuubin⟧) uses on its signs and notices, and it is what application forms instruct you to do. In casual speech, Japanese speakers often instead say ⟦ポスト→ポスト：02965_posuto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧ ('to put in the mailbox') or ⟦{手紙|てがみ}→手紙：00675_tegami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧ ('to send a letter').

Used both as a plain noun and as a ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧-verb: {投函|とうかん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ 'to mail, to post (something)'.

COMMON PATTERNS:
Transitive in its ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧-verb form. The thing being mailed is marked with ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧, and the location with ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧:
- ⟦{手紙|てがみ}→手紙：00675_tegami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ポスト→ポスト：02965_posuto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{投函|とうかん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to drop a letter in the mailbox
- The passive {投函|とうかん}⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧ is also common in postal-service notices.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{手紙|てがみ}→手紙：00675_tegami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{投函|とうかん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to mail a letter
- {葉書|はがき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{投函|とうかん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to mail a postcard
- ⟦ポスト→ポスト：02965_posuto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{投函|とうかん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to drop into a mailbox
- ⟦{投票|とうひょう}→投票：03453_touhyou⟧⟦{用紙|ようし}→用紙：09588_youshi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{投函|とうかん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to drop a ballot into the ballot box
- {投函|とうかん}{日|び}: posting date, mailing date
- {投函|とうかん}⟦{時|じ}→時：09869_ji⟧: at the time of mailing
- {投函口|とうかんぐち}: mail slot, drop-off slot (the opening of the box)
- {投函|とうかん}⟦{完了|かんりょう}→完了：02560_kanryou⟧: 'mailed' (a status notification)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{手紙|てがみ}→手紙：00675_tegami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧: to send a letter — the everyday spoken expression; covers both the act of mailing and the broader act of writing and sending. More casual.
- ⟦ポスト→ポスト：02965_posuto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧: to put in the mailbox — a plain spoken paraphrase of {投函|とうかん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧.
- ⟦{郵送|ゆうそう}→郵送：03176_yuusou⟧: mailing, sending by post — refers to the broader act of sending something through the postal system, including parcels handed over at a post office counter.
- ⟦{発送|はっそう}→発送：10458_hassou⟧: dispatch, sending out — more general; commonly used by online retailers about shipping orders.
- ⟦{差|さ}し{出|だ}す→差し出す：04234_sashidasu⟧: to send (a letter); to submit — formal verb for handing over or submitting documents.

REGISTER:
Formal/written. Common in postal-service signage, instructions on application forms, and news articles. In conversation, native speakers usually prefer the more colloquial ⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧ or ⟦ポスト→ポスト：02965_posuto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧.
